readerCopy.body: Affection can remain genuine while another person's desire, boundary, or preference sits directly across from what the relationship has been organized to expect. When Venus opposes Lilith, connection and autonomy face each other directly, making love, approval, money, or social ease part of a conflict over what can still be asked to stay hidden. The relationship does not automatically become wrong because the terms no longer fit. The tension becomes useful when affection stops being used as evidence that the difference should disappear.
